svg.text: Storyboard · Page 2 of 2 · Sections 5–7 (The Named · Conservation · Outro) · 16:9 · 9:30 documentary essay

g.text: Scene 24 · 5:00–5:12 · 12 sec · archival · then held still
ANGLE level, mesh in FG out-of-focus
PALETTE grey concrete · faded cinnamon · charcoal
SIZE Photo montage; CU on 6-mo frame
MOVE Ken Burns push on each frame
LIGHT fluorescent on early; ambient on late
TEXTURE archival grain; bottle, scale, toy
SOUND piano continues; cello PRIMES at ~6:25
5.6 · The empty incubator · the death beat
Scene 30 · 6:30–6:42 · 12 sec held · DO NOT MOVE CAMERA
HEIGHT eye-level (~1.1 m, seated subject height)
ANGLE level, centred (rare; earned by gravity)
MOVE STATIC · the longest held shot in the film
PALETTE clinical pale green · white · grey
TEXTURE glass, folded towel, plastic shell
SOUND piano returns · single sustained CELLO note
RESTRAINT no body · empty IS the body
PALETTE warm sepia · charcoal · ivory card
MOVE STATIC · no drift, no rack
LIGHT daylight from window-L only · no fill
PALETTE warm bone · skin · ochre wall
SOUND lavalier + room tone · NO SCORE
CONTINUITY earned by 8:30 of withholding face
7.2 · Wild mother + five cubs · final image
MOVE STATIC · USED AS-SHOT · no stab/crop
LIGHT dusk, low blue, last warm seam
PALETTE charcoal blue · ridge orange · grey
TEXTURE ridge stone, fur, dusk grain
SOUND wind · cello returns · warm chord enters

svg.text: After this panel: TITLE CARD on black · six names + Pirouz dates + blank seventh line · 10s hold + 3s held black · END.
The blank seventh line is the film's argument in punctuation. Protect it through delivery.
